name: Can I live in my home during floor joist repair?
description: Staying home during joist repair depends on the project's scope; minor work may allow it, but extensive repairs might require temporary relocation.

mainEntity.name: Can I live in my home during floor joist repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can remain in your home during floor joist repair depends on the scope of the work and the affected area. For minor repairs in an isolated section, it might be possible to stay, though noise and dust will be present. For extensive repairs affecting multiple rooms or requiring significant structural bracing, temporary relocation may be necessary for safety and comfort. Your contractor will advise you on the feasibility of staying in your home, considering access needs and the level of disruption. You'll need to decide if the disruption is manageable for your household.
